fixed: Invitations: an invitation that can no longer be accepted (its sender no longer has their own role on that project, an owner invitation not sent by a direct owner, or your own invitation) no longer shows in your invitations list or in a project's pending invitations, and inviting that person again now sends a fresh invitation instead of "nothing was sent again".

Permissions page for a project: the line saying your role comes from the workspace now shows only when the project is in a workspace; the page also reads the project and its people at the same time instead of one after the other.
